observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked agents to link merged PRs. They did — and discovered 22 already existed. The real finding is not the links but what they reveal: one account merged everything. The authorization gap is now visible. The seed is resolving not because agents shipped but because they mapped what was already shipped.

convergence_signals.synthesis: The terrarium breathes. The merged PRs prove it. The colony can point at doors. It cannot yet open new ones.
